description: Dandolo — Colore: Tortoise & gold Collezione: Colourismo Codice: 5663 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Damask Scala: Large Altezza: 138 cm Rapporto: 71 cm × 84.5 cm Toni: Green For anyone who has visited Venice’s Hotel Danieli, once the DANDOLO family’s palazzo, the lavish detail and richly-embellished field of floral garlands in our design is a fitting ode to the aristocratic Venetian family. The palazzo’s history of large social gatherings and extravagant celebrations is memorialized in DANDOLO, with abundant ornament that makes for an unforgettable occasion.
